g.text: Title: ADC startup gating and SPI connections

g.desc: Title: ADC startup gating and SPI connections

g.text: Sheet: /ADC startup gating and SPI connections/

g.desc: Sheet: /ADC startup gating and SPI connections/

g.text: SiT8008 +/-20 ppm on +3V3_ADC so the clock cannot drive an unpowered ADC. Route short, away from inputs.

g.desc: SiT8008 +/-20 ppm on +3V3_ADC so the clock cannot drive an unpowered ADC. Route short, away from inputs.

g.text: DOUT and DRDY return through series resistors near the ADC. ADS_RESET_N from the reset gate, 100k default low at the pin.

g.desc: DOUT and DRDY return through series resistors near the ADC. ADS_RESET_N from the reset gate, 100k default low at the pin.

g.text: CLKSEL low selects the external clock; DAISY and GPIO1-4 held low.

g.desc: CLKSEL low selects the external clock; DAISY and GPIO1-4 held low.

g.text: Place series resistors marked 'near ADC' at the ADS1299. Route CLK short and away from the electrode inputs.

g.desc: Place series resistors marked 'near ADC' at the ADS1299. Route CLK short and away from the electrode inputs.

g.text: ADC INTERFACE - MCU CONTROL LINES FORCED LOW UNTIL ADC_IO_READY

g.desc: ADC INTERFACE - MCU CONTROL LINES FORCED LOW UNTIL ADC_IO_READY

g.text: SN74LVC1G126 per control line: outputs tri-state and 10k pulls hold ADC pins low until ADC_IO_READY; 33R series near the ADC; 100k MCU-side defaults.

g.desc: SN74LVC1G126 per control line: outputs tri-state and 10k pulls hold ADC pins low until ADC_IO_READY; 33R series near the ADC; 100k MCU-side defaults.
